BiblicalUsage: Moshaah is deliverance, a going forth — blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, the God of our salvation, and unto GOD the Lord belong the issues from death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the deliverances are daily, not once: He loads us with benefits every morning, and death itself has its issues in His hand.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
